lines: Having done necessary duty purified having become then house; having taken refuge north-facing in triad of place body inner.
l4.sanskrit_cite: kṛtāvaśyakakartavyaḥ śuddho bhūtvā tato gṛham āśrityottaradigvaktraḥ sthānadehāntaratraye
